How to play

Points and stars

100 points for each right answer, up to 100 more for speed, and a bonus for 3 in a row. Mystery Country pays 400 on the first clue, down to 100. A Capital Pin bullseye earns 50 extra. Get 3, 6 or 9 right out of 10 for 1, 2 or 3 stars. Answer every kind of question about a country to earn its passport stamp.
